modelId.description: Model to pin to this scope. Must exist in `GET /models`.

routingPreference.description: How a HUB picks the upstream that serves the model (ADR 0166, RN-583). ABSENT keeps the stored value when the new model's provider accepts it, and clears it otherwise; `null` clears it; a value for a model whose provider does not declare the `routingPreference` capability (`GET /llm/provider-capabilities`) is refused with 422. It travels WITH this binding: it never cascades on its own.
